about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I’m Wadhah, a Software Developer and Technical Integration Engineer based in Mannheim, Germany. I have a telecommunications and network engineering background, with over two years of experience in full-stack development, SaaS integrations, REST APIs, databases, and technical troubleshooting.
about.paragraph2: My work has focused on building and integrating web applications, chatbot/SaaS platforms, backend services, and customer-specific solutions using technologies such as Java/Spring Boot, Node.js, React, Vue.js, TypeScript, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, MongoDB, MySQL, and PostgreSQL. I enjoy solving practical technical problems, connecting systems through APIs, and turning complex requirements into reliable software solutions.
